title: Every mistake becomes a test forever
description: fabrika's regression floor: every incident an agent causes becomes an eval case, and that floor must pass at 100%. It only ever rises.

scenes.text: Every mistake our agents make becomes a *test.*

scenes.before: Agent breaks something. Someone fixes it. It happens again next week.
scenes.after: The incident becomes an *eval case* the agents must pass.

scenes.label: required pass rate on the *regression floor*
